name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
short_summary: Collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh, a ₹15,000 toolkit voucher, and free skill training for 18 traditional trades.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits_json: ["PM Vishwakarma Certificate and digital ID card recognizing you as a registered artisan", "₹15,000 toolkit incentive as an e-voucher for modern tools", "Skill upgrade training with a ₹500/day stipend during training", "Collateral-free credit support: ₹1 lakh first tranche (18-month tenure), ₹2 lakh second tranche (30-month tenure) at 5% interest", "₹1 incentive per digital transaction (up to 100 transactions/month) to encourage digital payments", "Marketing support to help sell products, including linkage to e-commerce platforms"]

The operator will complete the biometric application for you.","link":"https://findmycsc.nic.in/"},{"mode":"online","label":"💻 Apply Online","detail":"Self-service registration portal at pmvishwakarma.gov.in.","link":"https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in"},{"mode":"helpline","label":"📞 Need Help?","detail":"Call the official toll-free helpline: 18002677777","link":"tel:18002677777"}]
after_apply_note: Your application is verified at the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body level, then recommended at the district level for approval. Once approved, you receive your PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card (digital and physical), which unlocks the toolkit voucher and training enrollment. The second loan tranche is only available after you meet the conditions tied to the first.
eligibility_summary: Artisans in 18 traditional trades, 18+ years old, self-employed.
benefits_offered: Collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh at 5%, ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, free training with ₹500/day stipend.
simple_summary: ₹15,000 tool voucher and loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
short_summary: Set up a new micro-enterprise with a bank loan covering up to 95% of project cost and a government subsidy of 15–35%.
benefits_json: ["A bank loan covering 90–95% of your project cost", "A government subsidy (margin money) of 15% to 35% depending on category and location — you never repay this portion", "Mandatory entrepreneurship development training to help you run the business", "Collateral-free financing under CGTMSE coverage for eligible loan amounts"]
eligibility_json: [{"condition":"I am 18 years of age or older","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I am setting up a NEW enterprise (existing or expanded units are not eligible)","hard_block":true},{"condition":"If my project costs more than ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹5 lakh (service), I have passed at least 8th standard","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I have not availed a subsidy under any other central or state government scheme for this same project","hard_block":true},{"condition":"Only one person from my family (self + spouse) is applying","hard_block":false}]
documents_json: [{"name":"Aadhaar card and PAN card","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Passport-size photographs","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Project report / Business proposal","fallback_note":"A simple write-up of what you plan to make/sell, expected cost, and expected income — DIC or CSC staff can help you draft this."},{"name":"Caste/category certificate (if applicable)","fallback_note":"Needed if claiming special category higher 25-35% subsidy rate."},{"name":"Educational qualification proof (8th standard pass certificate)","fallback_note":"Only needed for projects above ₹10 lakh in manufacturing."},{"name":"Udyam MSME Registration","fallback_note":"Can be done online for free before or during application at udyamregistration.gov.in."}]
apply_steps_json: [{"mode":"online","label":"💻 Apply on KVIC Portal (Online Only)","detail":"This scheme is administered digitally via the KVIC PMEGP e-portal. Upload project details and documents.","link":"https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal/"},{"mode":"in_person","label":"🏢 District Industries Centre (DIC)","detail":"Visit your local DIC office for in-person help drafting your project report and viability review.","link":null},{"mode":"helpline","label":"📞 KVIC National Helpline","detail":"Toll-free: 1800 180 6763 (Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM)","link":"tel:18001806763"}]
after_apply_note: DLTFC reviews and approves viable projects, then forwards them to a partner bank. The bank sanctions the loan; once you receive it, the subsidy portion is credited to your loan account after a period of satisfactory operation (usually verified around the 3-year mark).
eligibility_summary: 18+ years old, setting up new enterprise, 8th pass for > ₹10L projects.
benefits_offered: Bank loan covering up to 95% of project cost with 15–35% direct government subsidy.
simple_summary: 15-35% government subsidy on bank loans to start a craft production unit.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
short_summary: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for any small manufacturing, trading, or artisan business.
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefits_json: ["A collateral-free loan through any public or private bank, regional rural bank, or microfinance institution", "Three flexible loan tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001–₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh–₹10 lakh)", "Flexible repayment period up to 5 years", "Mudra Card (pre-loaded RuPay debit card) for seamless working capital drawdowns"]
eligibility_json: [{"condition":"I am an Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity (manufacturing, processing, trading, or crafts)","hard_block":true},{"condition":"My credit requirement is ₹10 lakh or less","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I am a small manufacturer, shopkeeper, or artisan (explicitly covers handloom, pottery, embroidery, woodcraft, and traditional trades)","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I do not have existing loan defaults with any bank or financial institution","hard_block":true}]
documents_json: [{"name":"Duly filled Mudra loan application form","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Identity proof (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, PAN, or Passport)","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Address proof (Aadhaar, utility bill, or bank statement)","fallback_note":null},{"name":"2 Passport-size photographs","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Proof of business / Quotation for tools or raw materials","fallback_note":"If starting a new unit, an estimate or quotation for raw materials/equipment is accepted."},{"name":"Last 6 months bank statement (if you have an existing account)","fallback_note":null}]
apply_steps_json: [{"mode":"in_person","label":"🏢 Nearest Bank Branch (Recommended)","detail":"Walk into any nationalized bank, regional rural bank (RRB), or cooperative bank near you with your KYC and craft equipment quote.","link":null},{"mode":"online","label":"💻 Udyamimitra Portal","detail":"Apply online to submit your proposal to multiple lenders simultaneously.","link":"https://www.udyamimitra.in/"},{"mode":"helpline","label":"📞 National Mudra Helpline","detail":"Toll-free: 1800 180 1111 / 1800 11 0001","link":"tel:18001801111"}]
after_apply_note: The bank evaluates your business plan and creditworthiness directly (there is no separate government approval step — Mudra is a framework banks operate under). Shishu loans are typically the fastest to sanction within 7–14 days.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizen, artisan or small enterprise, loan under ₹10 lakh.
benefits_offered: Collateral-free business loan up to ₹10 Lakh with flexible 5-year repayment.
simple_summary: Collateral-free loan from ₹50,000 to ₹10 Lakh to buy craft raw materials and tools.

name: PEHCHAN Artisan ID Card + NHDP
short_summary: Get an official artisan ID card unlocking craft workshops, marketing stalls, health insurance, and awards.
ministry: Ministry of Textiles, Office of DC (Handicrafts)
benefits_json: ["A PEHCHAN card — an Aadhaar-linked digital identity proving you are an officially registered handicraft artisan", "Access to free Design & Technology Upgradation workshops", "Health and life insurance under the Direct Benefit to Artisans component", "Eligibility to apply for National Awards and the Shilp Guru Award (India's highest recognition for master craftspeople)", "A monthly pension of ₹8,000 for senior awardee artisans in financial hardship (60+ years, income under ₹1 lakh/year)", "Priority access and subsidized stalls at prime government exhibitions: Dilli Haat, Surajkund Mela, and Gandhi Shilp Bazaars"]
eligibility_json: [{"condition":"I am a genuine, practicing artisan working in a recognized handicraft (not a trader or reseller)","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I am 18 years of age or older","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I can demonstrate my craft skill during local field verification or practical test","hard_block":true}]
eligible_trades_json: ["Handicraft","Pottery","Handloom","Embroidery","Wood Carving","Metal Engraving","Zari","Cane & Bamboo","Terracotta","Stone Craft","Glassware","Leather Craft","Folk Painting","Jewelry","Sculptor"]
documents_json: [{"name":"Aadhaar card","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Ration card (or family ID equivalent)","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Passport-size photographs","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Self-declaration/affidavit of craft practice","fallback_note":"A simple self-attested letter declaring your craft trade and years of practice."},{"name":"Proof of residence","fallback_note":"Aadhaar card, voter ID, or electricity bill."}]
apply_steps_json: [{"mode":"in_person","label":"🏢 Handicrafts Service Centre (HSC) (Recommended)","detail":"Visit your nearest Regional Office or Handicrafts Service Centre of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) for physical verification.","link":null},{"mode":"online","label":"💻 DC Handicrafts Portal","detail":"Apply online or check status at handicrafts.gov.in.","link":"http://handicrafts.nic.in/"},{"mode":"helpline","label":"📞 DC Handicrafts Helpdesk","detail":"Toll-free helpline: 1800 208 4800","link":"tel:18002084800"}]

eligibility_summary: Practicing handicraft artisan, 18+ years, skill demonstration.
benefits_offered: Official Pehchan photo ID card, design training workshops, health insurance, free exhibition stalls, Shilp Guru awards.
simple_summary: Official artisan ID card unlocking free fair stalls, health insurance, and design workshops.

short_summary: Priority access to branding, national exhibition stalls, shared machinery, and state margin-money subsidies.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
short_summary: Government guarantee that lets registered artisan units get collateral-free bank loans even without PMEGP or Mudra.
benefits_json: ["Access to bank loans without pledging your home, land, or family gold as security", "Coverage on both term loans (for machinery, kilns, looms) and working capital credit", "High guarantee coverage (up to 85% for women artisans and micro enterprises)", "Best suited for growing artisans who have outgrown Mudra Shishu/Kishor limits and need larger credit facilities"]
eligibility_json: [{"condition":"My enterprise is registered under Udyam (MSME registration)","hard_block":true},{"condition":"I am seeking a fresh credit facility (term loan or working capital) from a bank/NBFC that is a CGTMSE Member Lending Institution","hard_block":true},{"condition":"My craft enterprise fits within eligible micro/small manufacturing or service categories","hard_block":true},{"condition":"My unit has clean banking records with no active defaults","hard_block":true}]
documents_json: [{"name":"Udyam Registration Certificate","fallback_note":"Available online for free at udyamregistration.gov.in."},{"name":"Aadhaar card and PAN card","fallback_note":null},{"name":"Business financials and bank statements (last 6–12 months)","fallback_note":"Savings or current bank account statement from your primary branch."},{"name":"Project or working-capital requirement details","fallback_note":"A simple letter outlining what the loan will be used for (e.g. buying raw materials, expanding workshop)."}]
apply_steps_json: [{"mode":"in_person","label":"🏢 Member Bank Branch (Recommended)","detail":"You don't apply to CGTMSE directly — ask your bank (SBI, Canara Bank, PNB, Bank of Baroda, etc.) to sanction your loan 'under CGTMSE cover'.","link":null},{"mode":"online","label":"💻 CGTMSE Portal","detail":"Check list of member lending institutions and guarantee fee structures.","link":"https://www.cgtmse.in/"},{"mode":"helpline","label":"📞 CGTMSE Helpline","detail":"Call: 022-67221555 / 1800 220 988","link":"tel:1800220988"}]
after_apply_note: Your bank processes the loan application as usual; if approved under CGTMSE, the guarantee fee is added to your loan account and you're not asked for collateral.
scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for MSE (CGTMSE)
eligibility_summary: Udyam-registered enterprise seeking fresh bank credit.
benefits_offered: Collateral-free bank loan coverage up to ₹5 Crore without mortgaging property or gold.
simple_summary: Bank loan guarantee up to ₹5 Crore with zero property or gold collateral required.
